rows.text: its board approves buying **80% of AJC Jewel Manufacturers (FZC), Sharjah for Rs 9,59,96,946**, discharged entirely in up to 5,67,492 of its own shares at Rs 169.16 to a promoter-group transferor. The release is datelined 2 September and was carried in that day's digest.
